data.name: Plugin.Description
data.value: Reads hardware sensors and exposes them as Macro Deck variables.

data.name: Configuration.Description
data.value: The sensor window opens in your browser: the Macro Deck 2 dialog, with the whole tree of hardware, reading kind and sensor, and the polling rate under it. Press Continue to open it, and tick the sensors to publish as Macro Deck variables there - what you tick is what is saved. Sensors you leave out stay available from the variable catalog, and the names the Macro Deck 2 plugin used are kept, so an upgraded button keeps working.

data.name: Configuration.WindowRefused
data.value: The sensor window could not be opened in a browser. Press Continue to try again.

data.name: Configuration.WindowLost
data.value: The sensor window closed without sending its selection back. Press Continue to open it again.
